---
title: "Interior equipment lists"
---

Room-by-room checklists for furnishing and stocking a flat.
Incorporated from [issue #1](https://github.com/bastienchassagnol/Housework-items/issues/1).

## Temporary actions {#sec-interior-temporary}

- [ ] [Wardrobe kit with curtain](https://www.weldom.fr/p/kit-dressing-avec-rideau-blanc-mat-star-2-h-200-x-l-182-2-x-p-49-9-cm-89989259)

## Kitchen furniture and appliances {#sec-interior-kitchen}

- [ ] Fridge + freezer
- [ ] Microwave
- [ ] Oven
- [ ] Hob (induction adapter if needed)
- [ ] Kitchen table + chairs
- [ ] **Measuring jug**
- [ ] Coffee maker
- [ ] Kettle
- [ ] Placemats, boards
- [ ] Bowls, glasses, mugs
- [ ] Cutlery, and spatulas (wood and plastic) / ladle
- [ ] **Plates**
- [ ] Mixing bowl (salad bowl)
- [ ] **Frying pans**
- [ ] Saucepans
- [ ] **Lids**
- [ ] Vegetable peeler
- [ ] Electric hand mixer
- [ ] Blender
- [ ] Food processor
- [ ] Grater
- [ ] **Colander**
- [ ] Draining rack
- [ ] Tea towels
- [ ] Washing-up liquid
- [ ] **Soap**
- [ ] Kitchen scales
- [ ] **Whisk**
- [ ] Aluminium foil, baking parchment, baking paper
- [ ] **Knife sharpener**
- [ ] Bin + bin bags
- [ ] **Chopping board**

## Food (to get started) {#sec-interior-food}

- [ ] Oil, spices (pepper, curry, paprika), salt
- [ ] Garlic, onions, shallots
- [ ] Potatoes
- [ ] Ice packs
- [ ] Flour, sugar
- [ ] Pasta, rice
- [ ] Pâté, cured sausages
- [ ] Jam
- [ ] Baking kit (vanilla, yeast)
- [ ] **Honey**
- [ ] **Coffee, herbal teas**
- [ ] **Single-portion tinned goods**

## Bedding and bedroom {#sec-interior-bedroom}

- [ ] Wardrobe for clothes + hangers
- [ ] Bed (base + mattress)
- [ ] Duvet and sheet
- [ ] Pillows and pillowcases
- [ ] Bedside table
- [ ] Lamp (**second lamp**)
- [ ] Camp beds
- [ ] Sofa bed (fold-out)
- [ ] Shoe storage furniture
- [ ] **Plastic crates / stacking towers**

## Bathroom and shower {#sec-interior-bathroom}

- [ ] Brush
- [ ] Mop (bucket) + dustpan and brush
- [ ] Vacuum cleaner
- [ ] Bath mat
- [ ] First-aid kit + sun cream
- [ ] Plasters + antiseptic
- [ ] Toothbrush, nail clippers, safety pin, toothpaste
- [ ] Razor (manual + electric), shaving foam
- [ ] Bathroom scales
- [ ] Floor cleaner
- [ ] Toilet cleaner (drains) and/or limescale remover
- [ ] (wood cleaner)
- [ ] Glass cleaner
- [ ] White vinegar + bicarbonate of soda
- [ ] Laundry detergent
- [ ] Washing machine
- [ ] Clothes airers
- [ ] Shower curtain, rail
- [ ] Laundry basket
- [ ] Toilet paper
- [ ] Gloves and towels

## Clothing and sport {#sec-interior-clothing}

- [ ] Underwear
- [ ] Rain clothing
- [ ] Sportswear
- [ ] Summer clothing
- [ ] Casual wear (baggy trousers, jumpers)
- [ ] Suit
- [ ] Shoes (*3 pairs*)
- [ ] Hydration pack
- [ ] Bicycles + locks + helmet + gloves + cap
- [ ] Water bottles and thermos flasks
- [ ] Slippers and flip-flops
- [ ] Swimming gear

## Work {#sec-interior-work}

- [ ] Computers
- [ ] Extension lead and chargers
- [ ] Graphics tablet
- [ ] Notebooks, pencil case, **stamps**, envelopes
- [ ] Desk, lamp, office chair
- [ ] External hard drive, power bank
- [ ] Headphones

## Leisure {#sec-interior-leisure}

- [ ] Electronic kit (chargers, Ethernet cable, …)
- [ ] Hiking rucksack
- [ ] Hiking equipment (head torch, …)
- [ ] Bicycle, bottle, repair kit, track pump
- [ ] DIY tools
- [ ] Books + bookcase
- [ ] **Board games**, playing cards
